title: Separate raw support rules earn paid activation without frozen landings
statement: Separate sufficient families have one port0->A(lambda),A->0(mu A),positive fixed rates,and otherwise total-count-conserving reactions. For largest internal degree m>=2,the degree-m source-support closure must reach A from EVERY singleton support. Finite witness chains acquire positive uniform leading-ODE A density for every initial composition,then explicit compensated-Poisson/Gronwall finite-N bounds on an actual interval T n^(1-m). All real port/internal jumps,holding time,failed tracking and actual outputs are charged at one V=t^N off a finite head,F=(1+q)u^N,1<u<t. Per-observation contraction may be polynomially small n^(2-m);no uniform mixing or stationary shell law is assumed. Nonexplosion follows from N<=N0+Pois(lambda time);classwise finite physical return rewards and Epi[(1+q)e^(rN)]for everyr>0 follow under the stated actual-class/weak-reversibility guards. Catalytic variant requires EVERY internal source AND product to contain aA,a>=1;after subtracting it,residual conservative degree ell>=2 has the same leading-support closure. Exact(X)_(aA+y)=(A)_a(R)_y restores operational clock du=(A)_a dt,with bounded operational birth/death hazards lambda/a! andmu/(a-1)!. Actual subgate seeding,persistence,all failed activations and a real mature draining interval H/n are paid,using polynomially many controlled operational blocks,no profile reset. Rational constructors acquire explicit guarded finite heads;three cooperative fixtures have14841–22442bit heads. Those are NOT a numerical exponent/head/normalizer for the neutral coupled theorem. Common catalytic gate/support assumptions exclude accepted N1621 A-free CD-source model;no automatic extension to arbitrary conservative cores,unbounded interacting debts or unrestricted weak reversibility. Source checks(7920factorial identities/1017full-generator inequalities/144coupled ratios)are reported,not Capital executions.

requires: Finite genuine weakly reversible raw mass-action lists with fixed positive rate constants and ordinary falling-factorial propensities. Each operation retains its own exact guard;integer endpoints and rational-rate arithmetic for the exact numerical constructors.

Raw neutral graph/cone coverage is acquired before applying the multiplicative physical-return calculus. Conservative support/catalytic and reciprocal-bath families have separate conservation,port,gate/support/graph premises.
provides: Exact statement above, at the stated contract.
costs: Complete profile,mark,neutral-graph and exact cone/word acquisition;finite rational rate evaluation and all competing outputs,residence and genuine reaction activity paid. No polynomial complexity or free receiving-law/mixing oracle.

Coupled numerical exponent/head/normalizer uncomputed. Separate support heads can require14841–22442bits;reciprocal diagnostic heads31–50bits. Those are guarded mathematical sufficient data,not practical stationary solvers or a head for the coupled family.
contract.units: Physical holding time,genuine jump activity q,stationary factorial/count rewards,exponential physical-return moments and computational work are separate. Existence of an exponent/head/normalizer is not its numerical acquisition.
contract.obstruction: Same-principal new proofs and producer-reported exact checks;no independent audit or novelty clearance. Main neutral/coupled exponent,head radius and stationary normalizer are uncomputed. Every structural guard and physical-return scope is retained;separate sufficient operations do not compose into unrestricted recurrence. No practical or physical-chemistry claim;chemistry non-operational.
